+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+
+@dataclass
+class PartialRecognitionState:
+    provider: str = "assemblyai"
+    partial_text: str = ""
+    final_text: str = ""
+    partials: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    finals: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    def apply_event(self, event: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[str]:
+        event_type = event.get("type") or event.get("event") or event.get("status")
+        text = event.get("text") or event.get("transcript") or ""
+        if not text and isinstance(event.get("result"), dict):
+            text = event["result"].get("text", "")
+
+        if event_type in {"partial", "interim", "in_progress", "transcript.partial"}:
+            self.partial_text = text
+            if text:
+                self.partials.append(text)
+            return self.partial_text
+
+        if event_type in {"final", "completed", "recognized", "transcript.final"}:
+            if text:
+                self.finals.append(text)
+                self.final_text = (self.final_text + " " + text).strip() if self.final_text else text
+            self.partial_text = ""
+            return self.final_text
+
+        if event_type == "error":
+            raise ValueError(event.get("message") or event.get("error") or "Streaming recognition error")
+
+        if text:
+            self.partial_text = text
+            self.partials.append(text)
+            return self.partial_text
+
+        return None
+
+    def snapshot(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        return {
+            "provider": self.provider,
+            "partial_text": self.partial_text,
+            "final_text": self.final_text,
+            "partials": list(self.partials),
+            "finals": list(self.finals),
+            "metadata": dict(self.metadata),
+        }
+
+
+def handle_streaming_event(state: PartialRecognitionState, event: Any) -> Optional[str]:
+    if isinstance(event, str):
+        event = json.loads(event)
+    if not isinstance(event, dict):
+        raise TypeError("event must be a dict or JSON string")
+    state.metadata.update({k: v for k, v in event.items() if k not in {"type", "event", "status", "text", "transcript", "result", "message", "error"}})
+    return state.apply_event(event)
+
+
+def create_state() -> PartialRecognitionState:
+    return PartialRecognitionState()

+import asyncio
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, AsyncIterator, Awaitable, Callable, Optional
+
+import websockets
+
+
+AssemblyAI_WS_URL = "wss://api.assemblyai.com/v2/realtime/ws"
+
+
+async def stream_audio_chunks(
+    source: AsyncIterator[bytes],
+    on_chunk: Callable[[bytes], Awaitable[None]],
+    *,
+    sample_rate: int = 16000,
+    token: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> None:
+    auth_token = token or os.environ.get("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY") or os.environ.get("ASSEMBLYAI_TOKEN")
+    if not auth_token:
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing AssemblyAI auth token in ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY or ASSEMBLYAI_TOKEN")
+
+    url = f"{AssemblyAI_WS_URL}?sample_rate={sample_rate}"
+    headers = {"Authorization": auth_token}
+
+    async with websockets.connect(url, extra_headers=headers) as ws:
+        async def sender() -> None:
+            async for chunk in source:
+                if not chunk:
+                    continue
+                payload = base64.b64encode(chunk).decode("ascii")
+                await ws.send(json.dumps({"audio_data": payload}))
+            await ws.send(json.dumps({"terminate_session": True}))
+
+        async def receiver() -> None:
+            async for message in ws:
+                if isinstance(message, bytes):
+                    await on_chunk(message)
+                    continue
+                try:
+                    data: Any = json.loads(message)
+                except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                    continue
+                audio_data = data.get("audio_data")
+                if isinstance(audio_data, str) and audio_data:
+                    await on_chunk(base64.b64decode(audio_data))
+
+        await asyncio.gather(sender(), receiver())
+
+
+__all__ = ["stream_audio_chunks"]
*** End Patch

+import asyncio
+import os
+from typing import AsyncIterator, Optional
+
+import sounddevice as sd
+from deepgram import DeepgramClient, LiveOptions, LiveTranscriptionEvents
+
+
+class MicrophoneStream:
+    def __init__(self, sample_rate: int = 16000, channels: int = 1, blocksize: int = 1024):
+        self.sample_rate = sample_rate
+        self.channels = channels
+        self.blocksize = blocksize
+        self._queue: asyncio.Queue[bytes] = asyncio.Queue()
+        self._stream: Optional[sd.RawInputStream] = None
+
+    def _audio_callback(self, indata, frames, time_info, status):
+        if status:
+            pass
+        self._queue.put_nowait(bytes(indata))
+
+    async def generator(self) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        self._stream = sd.RawInputStream(
+            samplerate=self.sample_rate,
+            blocksize=self.blocksize,
+            channels=self.channels,
+            dtype="int16",
+            callback=lambda indata, frames, time_info, status: loop.call_soon_threadsafe(
+                self._audio_callback, indata, frames, time_info, status
+            ),
+        )
+        self._stream.start()
+        try:
+            while True:
+                chunk = await self._queue.get()
+                yield chunk
+        finally:
+            if self._stream is not None:
+                self._stream.stop()
+                self._stream.close()
+
+
+async def stream_microphone() -> AsyncIterator[str]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY is required")
+
+    client = DeepgramClient(api_key)
+    dg_connection = client.listen.asynclive.v("1")
+
+    transcript_queue: asyncio.Queue[str] = asyncio.Queue()
+
+    def on_message(result, **kwargs):
+        channel = result.channel
+        alternatives = getattr(channel, "alternatives", None) or []
+        if not alternatives:
+            return
+        transcript = alternatives[0].transcript
+        if transcript:
+            transcript_queue.put_nowait(transcript)
+
+    dg_connection.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Transcript, on_message)
+
+    options = LiveOptions(
+        model="nova-2",
+        punctuate=True,
+        interim_results=True,
+        language="en-US",
+        encoding="linear16",
+        channels=1,
+        sample_rate=16000,
+    )
+
+    await dg_connection.start(options)
+
+    mic = MicrophoneStream()
+
+    async def send_audio():
+        async for chunk in mic.generator():
+            await dg_connection.send(chunk)
+
+    sender = asyncio.create_task(send_audio())
+    try:
+        while True:
+            yield await transcript_queue.get()
+    finally:
+        sender.cancel()
+        with contextlib.suppress(asyncio.CancelledError):
+            await sender
+        await dg_connection.finish()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import contextlib
+
+    async def main():
+        async for transcript in stream_microphone():
+            print(transcript, flush=True)
+
+    asyncio.run(main())
